commands.name: followups.list
commands.description: List the person's follow-ups: dated promises they owe and are owed, from their mail and what they typed. Dates come from Emergic's rules, never a model. Each has a key for followups.close.

when.description: Which ones: open (default), due (late plus today), late, today, upcoming, undated, or closed

commands.name: followups.add
commands.description: Add a follow-up in the person's words, e.g. "Send Ravi the PO by Friday". The due day is read from the words by Emergic's rules, counted from today; with no day named it has no date.

what.description: What is owed, with when if known

owed.description: true when someone owes the person; leave out when the person owes it

who.description: Who it is owed to or by (optional)

commands.name: followups.close
commands.description: Close a follow-up as done or dropped, or reopen it, by the key from followups.list. how also takes the person's own word, e.g. "done" or "drop it".

how.description: done (default), dropped, open to reopen, or the person's own word

commands.name: followups.check
commands.description: Read the last 14 days of the person's mail through Mail for new dated promises, and close open ones that a later reply in the same thread answered. Needs Gmail connected in Mail. Never changes mail.
